responsibility: Defines the inference-side canonicalization entry points that bring canonical values into a fresh `InferCtxt`, recreating inference variables or placeholders for each canonical variable and applying those instantiations to the canonical payload.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the canonical-query instantiation boundary within inference. Its `InferCtxt` methods recreate canonical variables as fresh inference vars or placeholders, including universe remapping, and substitute them back into canonical values; the other `infer/*/mod.rs` files mostly operate on already-live local inference state rather than importing canonicalized query data.
